q: 2018 年 8 月的客单价是多少？
gold: SELECT sum(gmv) / count(*) FROM v_order_fact WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND order_date >= '2018-08-01' AND order_date < '2018-09-01'

q: 各支付方式的订单数分别是多少？（不区分订单状态）
gold: SELECT payment_type, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM order_payments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 ASC

q: 评分大于等于 4 的订单占比是多少？
gold: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN review_score >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM order_reviews

q: 2018 年 8 月有多少活跃买家？
gold: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM v_order_fact WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND order_date >= '2018-08-01' AND order_date < '2018-09-01'

q: 延迟交付率是多少？（签收时间晚于承诺送达时间）
gold: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

q: 复购间隔的中位数是多少天？
gold: WITH o AS (SELECT customer_unique_id, order_date, lag(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_unique_id ORDER BY order_date) AS prev FROM v_order_fact WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')) SELECT median(date_diff('day', prev, order_date)) FROM o WHERE prev IS NOT NULL

q: GMV 最高的 5 个商品类别是哪些？（返回英文品类名和 GMV）
gold: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category, sum(oi.price) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 ASC LIMIT 5

q: 运费占 GMV 的比例是多少？
gold: SELECT sum(freight) / sum(gmv) FROM v_order_fact WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

q: GMV 最高的 10 个卖家贡献了总 GMV 的多少比例？
gold: WITH s AS (SELECT oi.seller_id, sum(oi.price) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT gmv, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY gmv DESC) AS rn FROM s) SELECT sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 10) / sum(gmv) FROM r

q: 2018 年 8 月相对 7 月的 GMV 环比增长率是多少？
gold: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, sum(gmv) AS gmv FROM v_order_fact WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1) SELECT (SELECT gmv FROM m WHERE ym = '2018-08') / (SELECT gmv FROM m WHERE ym = '2018-07') - 1
